name: Outlets at Lake Elsinore
summary: Outlets at Lake Elsinore is a 318,000 square foot outlet shopping center featuring over 20 brand-name retailers including Levi's, Vans, Gap, and Guess. Located in Lake Elsinore, California, this open-air destination offers significant savings on quality merchandise in a convenient Inland Empire location.
demographics: Outlets at Lake Elsinore primarily serves middle-income families and value-conscious shoppers from the Inland Empire region, including Lake Elsinore, Temecula, Murrieta, and surrounding Riverside County communities. The trade area attracts a diverse demographic mix with household incomes ranging from $50,000 to $90,000, including young families, retirees, and bargain hunters seeking brand-name merchandise at discounted prices. Visitors typically range from ages 25-65, with a strong representation of Hispanic and Caucasian households who prioritize value shopping and are willing to drive 20-40 minutes for outlet deals. The center benefits from weekend tourism traffic and serves as a regional destination for discount shopping in Southern California's growing Inland Empire market.
description: Outlets at Lake Elsinore is a premier outlet shopping destination located in the heart of Lake Elsinore, California, offering exceptional value on brand-name merchandise. This 318,000 square foot open-air shopping center features over 20 popular retailers including Levi's, Vans, Gap, and Guess, providing shoppers with significant savings on quality apparel, footwear, and accessories. Strategically positioned in Riverside County's rapidly growing Inland Empire region, the center serves as a convenient shopping hub for residents and visitors seeking outlet prices without the drive to more distant locations. The property is professionally managed by Athena Property Management and offers a comfortable shopping environment with ample parking and easy freeway access. With operating hours seven days a week and extended hours on Fridays and Saturdays, Outlets at Lake Elsinore provides a family-friendly atmosphere where value-conscious shoppers can discover deals from their favorite brands while enjoying the Southern California climate in an outdoor shopping setting.
